About the team

OpenAI’s mission is to build safe artificial general intelligence (AGI) which benefits all of humanity. This long-term undertaking brings the world’s best scientists, engineers, and business professionals into one lab together to accomplish this.

In pursuit of this mission, our Go To Market (GTM) team is responsible for helping customers learn how to leverage and deploy our highly capable AI products across their business. The team is made of Sales, Solutions, Support, Marketing, and Partnership professionals that work together to create valuable solutions that will help bring AI to as many users as possible.

About the role

Our Sales team has a unique mission to help customers understand the deep impact that highly capable AI models can bring to their business and users. This role is a mixture of technical understanding, vision, partnership, and value-driven strategy.

You’ll be a key driver of opportunities through the entire sales cycle, from pipeline generation to closure. You’ll work with researchers, engineers, and solution strategists to help customers evolve their industry with AI.

This role can be based in our San Francisco or Seattle offices. We are also considering applications to work remotely from within the U.S. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In this role, you'll:

- Manage ~five key accounts, developing and executing strategies for a comprehensive account plan

- Lead our enterprise customers’ journeys from ideation to successful deployment

- Partner with solutions and research engineering to build and execute complex customer programs and projects

- Own a consumption revenue target

- Collaborate with solutions, marketing, communications, business operations, people operations, finance, product management, and engineering

- Support the recruitment and onboarding of other teammates

- Support the development of company culture

We're seeking someone with experience including:

- 14+ years selling platform-as-a-service and/or software-as-a-service

- Achieving revenue targets >$1M per year for more than 3 years

- Designing and executing complex deal strategies

- Supporting the growth of fast-growing, high-performance companies

- Working directly with c-level executives

- Communicating technical concepts to customers and internal stakeholders

- Leading high-visibility customer events (CAB, conferences, product launches, etc.)

- Gathering, distilling, and processing complex market (industry, competitor, customer, prospect) intelligence

You might thrive in this role if you:

- Are customer-centric. You are motivated to deeply understand your customer’s priorities and help them achieve their vision for using our models to improve their products and services. You build strong relationships with executives and professionals across functions and serve as a trusted advisor.

- Have a passion or deep curiosity in artificial intelligence. You embrace the opportunity to help deploy our technology in a way that benefits humanity. You’re excited to educate our customers on AI and how to plan for the future.

Supply Analyst - Aviation Fuel (Europe)

Location: Canary Wharf, London

The Supply Analyst, Aviation Fuel (Europe) is responsible for bulk fuel supply operations, logistics, scheduling, and fuel-related services across the European region. Inventory Management & Scheduling

•

Actively manage and schedule fuel inventories to maintain optimal stock balances.

•

Ensure accurate and efficient scheduling of fuel deliveries into inventory locations.

•

Liaise with Into-Plane (ITP) agents, suppliers, and service providers to support inventory requirements.

Pipeline Scheduling & Truck Dispatch

•

Schedule and monitor pipeline and truck deliveries into inventory locations.

•

Assess and develop the most effective supply mix based on current and potential supply options.

Transaction Processing & Administration

•

Ensure timely and accurate entry, verification, and processing of bulk transactions.

•

Manage associated payments and receivables.

Analyse supply and demand trends across assigned inventory locations.

Identify opportunities to enhance supply chain value and optimise supply arrangements.

Coordinate daily with haulage providers and operational sites regarding missed deliveries or delivery issues.

Fluent English, with excellent written and verbal communication skills.

ÉQUIPE : RESPONSABLE DES COMPTES

APERÇU DE L’ENTREPRISE

Salt XC est une agence animée par la philosophie du commerce expérientiel. Notre cadre unique, Experiential CommerceMC, nous permet de concevoir de meilleures expériences pour les consommateurs qui attirent l’attention et incitent à l’action. Nous adoptons une approche intégrée qui relie les expériences en ligne et hors ligne de vos consommateurs par le biais de données, de médias et de moments mémorables qui stimulent les transactions de la marque.

APERÇU

Le coordonnateur de comptes est un membre de l’équipe qui collabore et s’engage à soutenir l’équipe et le client selon les besoins. Il travaille directement avec l’équipe des comptes pour comprendre comment et quand il peut apporter son soutien et mettre en place un plan pour le faire. Un coordinateur de comptes-clients efficace est proactif, positif et enthousiasmé par les offres de l’entreprise et la façon dont elles créent de la valeur pour les clients. Vous êtes un communicateur habile, tant à l’oral qu’à l’écrit, et vous avez d’excellentes compétences en matière de présentation, de service à la clientèle, de gestion du temps et d’informatique.

RESPONSABILITÉS PRINCIPALES

Relations avec les clients

• Accomplir les tâches pour le compte de votre client en ligne, hors ligne et partout entre les deux, le cas échéant.
• L’accomplissement des tâches peut nécessiter un travail sur le terrain, en ligne ou au bureau, et variera en fonction des programmes.
• Communiquer avec les clients selon les nécessités, pour comprendre leurs besoins et transmettre ces informations à votre gestionnaire ou à votre équipe, et agir en conséquence.
• Maintenir une connaissance actualisée des produits et services des clients.
• Déterminer les tendances du secteur d’activités et les communiquer aux personnes concernées.
• Agir comme un prolongement de votre client tout au long de la planification, de la réalisation et de la conclusion du programme — en gardant toujours les besoins de votre client à l’esprit.

Équipe

• Collaborer avec votre équipe directe pour répondre aux besoins du client.
• Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les partenaires et les fournisseurs pour s’assurer qu’ils disposent de tous les outils et de toutes les informations nécessaires pour soutenir vos activités.
• Former, intégrer, planifier, diriger et gérer les ambassadeurs de la marque, selon les besoins.
• Entretenir des contacts réguliers avec votre gestionnaire, en veillant à ce qu’il soit au courant de vos activités, qu’il soit informé des avancées concernant le client et qu’il puisse vous soutenir en cas de besoin.

Financial Finances

• Établir de petits budgets à la demande de votre gestionnaire.
• Gérer et superviser les composantes des budgets moyens et gros.
• Rapprocher les petits budgets; rester en contact étroit avec votre équipe pour la soutenir si nécessaire.
• Respecter le budget en toutes circonstances et être capable de reconnaître si un budget n’est pas suffisant et d’en informer votre gestionnaire.
• Gérer les achats au nom du client et de l’entreprise, et mettre en œuvre des pratiques détaillées de gestion des dépenses afin de s’assurer que toutes les dépenses des employés et de l’entreprise sont rapprochées en temps opportun et de manière correcte.

Gestion de projet

• Relever les défis et faire des suggestions pour améliorer les processus.
• Soutenir les équipes et les comités de Salt pour créer une culture positive et mettre à l’essai ou en œuvre de nouvelles politiques, procédures et processus.
• Appuyer votre équipe avec des projets auxiliaires qui soutiennent le client ou Salt sur une base quotidienne.

EXPÉRIENCE ET COMPÉTENCES

• De 1 à 3 ans d’expérience dans le domaine du marketing, avec une expérience dans la réalisation de programmes pour le compte d’un client.
• Excellentes compétences en communication orale et écrite.
• Capacité d’adaptation et une excellente aptitude à résoudre les problèmes.
• Excellentes capacités d’écoute active et de gestion du temps.
• Capacité à établir des relations et à collaborer avec d’autres personnes à l’interne et à l’externe
• Sens de l’organisation et capacité d’effectuer plusieurs tâches à la fois, si nécessaire.
• Attitude proactive avec une passion pour la satisfaction de l’équipe et du client.
• Haut niveau d’efficacité et de précision.
• Très bonnes compétences technologiques de base — connaissance d’Office 365, des outils de médias sociaux et numériques.
• Passion pour le marketing et les partenariats

EXIGENCES

About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

As the Sales Enablement Partner, Claude Products, you'll teach Anthropic's global field organization how to use our products, both to do their own work better and to position Claude credibly with customers. Anthropic ships quickly, and the surface area of what we build is growing faster than any individual seller can track. The job has two halves. The first is enabling our own people to be power users of Claude, so the field is the most sophisticated user of the product we sell. The second is enabling them to position it: to run a credible technical conversation with a customer, anticipate the hard questions, and hold their own with a technical buyer.

The best person in this role sees around corners. You won't wait for a launch to be announced before you start building enablement for it. You'll be embedded enough with Product and Applied AI to know what's coming, and opinionated enough to say which surfaces need real enablement investment and which don't. You'll need enough technical credibility to earn the respect of engineers and enough commercial fluency to earn the respect of sellers. You should also find more energy in enabling people to use what we build than in building it yourself.

Key responsibilities:

• Own product enablement for the global field organization, spanning new launches, existing capabilities, and the product roadmap ahead
• Build the programs that make Anthropic sellers genuinely expert users of Claude in their own daily work
• Create enablement that equips the field to position our products with technical and business buyers, including demo readiness, objection handling, and competitive framing
• Partner closely with Product, Product Marketing, and Applied AI to get early visibility into what is shipping and to shape how it reaches the field
• Anticipate which new product surfaces will require significant enablement investment, and make the case for that investment before launch
• Build and maintain the product certification path that credentials sellers on our core products
• Create high-quality enablement content including demo scripts, technical talk tracks, solution guides, and competitive positioning material
• Establish feedback loops that carry field and customer signal about product gaps back to Product and Product Marketing

Minimum qualifications:

•

Experience bridging sales and technical audiences in a role such as solutions engineering, sales engineering, technical enablement, product marketing, or technical account management

•

Hands-on, regular use of AI assistants and agentic tools (e.g., Claude, Claude Code) in your own real-world workflows

Working technical knowledge of how LLM products work (e.g., prompting, context, tool use, APIs), enough to demo them live and field technical questions from engineering buyers

Experience turning complex, fast-moving technical products into enablement content such as demo scripts, technical talk tracks, solution guides, or training curricula

•

Experience writing and presenting technical material for audiences with very different levels of technical depth

Preferred qualifications

•

Hands-on experience building with LLM APIs, agentic frameworks, or developer tooling

•

Experience owning launch readiness for a technical product across a global field organization

•

Prior experience as a solutions engineer or sales engineer carrying a technical win

•

Experience building technical certification programs

•

A track record of shipping enablement content that the field actually uses

•

Experience partnering with Product or Product Marketing to prepare a field team ahead of launch, not after it

•

Experience building programs from 0 to 1 in fast-paced, ambiguous environments

Annual Salary:

$190,000—$270,000 USD

Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

jobs.description: Come join us in our journey to make everything – and yes, we do mean *everything* – that anyone wants to buy, available on Amazon! We are looking for a Software Development Manager with strong technical knowledge, established background in engineering large scale software systems, and passion for solving challenging problems. The role demands a high-performing and flexible candidate who can take responsibility for success of the team, systems, and drive solutions from definition to launch to achieve results in a fast paced environment. The SDM on this team will be playing a key role in defining charter/scope, executing, and delivering innovative solutions to drive complete and correct selection on Amazon's eCommerce platform world wide. Candidate needs to have a high sense of ownership, ability to take on ambiguous and ambitious goals, and lead a highly talented team to achieve results. This role would expose you to solving problems at scale in areas of Agentic AI, automated insights, large scale data processing, and distributed systems . Key job responsibilities As a member of the team, in this role, you will: * Work with Org leadership, Principal Engineers to define and drive the technical and architectural vision of Selection Monitoring’s External E-commerce source discovery and enrichment. * Build and launch scalable, fault-tolerant, and highly available services and AI Agents that can solve complex problems in entity resolution, deduplication, classification, enrichments and 3rd party data integrations to automatically discovery, catalog, and refresh meta information and signals for millions of eCommerce websites worldwide. * Build and launch efficient storage solutions for managing large-scale datasets, ensuring optimal performance for both write-heavy ingestion and read-heavy analytical workloads. * Build and grow a team of high performing SDEs, and be responsible and invested in career growth of your team members. * Drive operational excellence initiatives and continuously improve quality bar for software delivered by the team. Our systems process billions of products from millions of sources to algorithmically find products not already sold on Amazon and programmatically add them to the Amazon catalog. We apply parallel processing, AI/GenAI, machine learning and deep learning algorithms to evaluate products and brands in order to identify and prioritize products and brands to be added to Amazon’s catalog. The datasets produced by our team are used by teams across Amazon to improve: product information, search and discoverability, pricing, and delivery experience. Our work involves building state-of-the-art Information Retrieval (IR) systems to mine the web and automatically create structured entities from un-structure/semi-structured data. We constantly stretch the boundaries of large scale distributed systems, Elastic Computing, Big Data, Artificial intelligence and SOA technologies to tackle challenges at Amazon’s global scale.

SpaceXAI’s mission is to create AI systems that can accurately understand the universe and aid humanity in its pursuit of knowledge. Our team is small, highly motivated, and focused on engineering excellence. This organization is for individuals who appreciate challenging themselves and thrive on curiosity. We operate with a flat organizational structure. All employees are expected to be hands-on and to contribute directly to the company’s mission. Leadership is given to those who show initiative and consistently deliver excellence. Work ethic and strong prioritization skills are important. All employees are expected to have strong communication skills. They should be able to concisely and accurately share knowledge with their teammates.

• Design, build, and implement a large-scale distributed system that powers one of the world's largest supercomputing clusters.

• Systems programming experience in C, C++, or Rust

• Solid understanding of computer networks and the TCP/IP stack
• Experience working with Linux kernel concepts or systems-level debugging tools (e.g., perf, gdb, strace, Wireshark)

• Experience with observability and monitoring in distributed systems (Prometheus, Grafana, VictoriaMetrics, OpenTelemetry, or similar)

$180,000 - $440,000 USD

Regional Security Advisor, Asia Pacific

Reports To: Director, Global Security & Investigations

Position Summary

Asia Pacific is one of the most dynamic and complex operating environments in the world, shaped by geopolitical tension, rapid economic change, natural hazards, and varied regulatory and cultural landscapes. As the senior security leader for the region, you will define and drive a security vision that protects our people, manufacturing footprint, assets, and reputation while enabling the company's growth ambitions.

You will be a strategic partner to regional and country leadership, shaping decisions on market entry, site selection, expansion, and risk appetite. You will translate global security strategy into a regional program that is mature, measurable, and adapted to each country. You will also build the organization, partnerships, and resilience that make the company a secure and credible presence across the region. This is a role for a leader who thinks at enterprise scale and can operate both at the boardroom table and on the plant floor.

You Will Be Responsible For:

Strategic Vision & Enterprise Risk Leadership

• Defining and owning a multi-year Asia Pacific security strategy and roadmap, aligned to global priorities and integrated with regional business plans
• Anticipating geopolitical, economic, criminal, civil unrest, terrorism, and climate-related risks, and translating them into clear strategic guidance and scenario planning for senior leadership
• Leading regional risk assessments and turning the findings into prioritized, risk-based investment decisions for people, travelers, facilities, and assets
• Advising on the security implications of major business decisions, including market entry, acquisitions, divestitures, site selection, and supply chain footprint
• Contributing regional insight and thought leadership to the global security strategy, helping shape enterprise policy, standards, and investment priorities

Resilience, Crisis & Incident Leadership

• Owning regional crisis management, business continuity, and emergency preparedness, including governance, exercises, and a culture of continuous improvement
• Serving as the senior security lead during significant incidents, guiding executive decision-making, coordinating cross-functional response, and escalating to the Director, Global Security & Investigations
• Ensuring lessons from incidents and after-action reviews become lasting improvements to the program
• Overseeing sensitive investigations, the travel security risk program, and executive protection, with appropriate discretion and independence

Program Ownership & Organizational Capability

• Owning the regional implementation of global security policies and standards, defining metrics that demonstrate effectiveness, maturity, and value
• Partnering with the Global Security Operations Support Team to drive enterprise-wide standardization and technology-enabled solutions
• Building and leading the regional security organization as the program matures, including setting direction, developing talent, and providing oversight for those responsible for security at manufacturing plants and other facilities
• Managing regional security budgets, vendors, and service providers to deliver strong outcomes and value

Executive Influence & Ecosystem Leadership

• Serving as the principal security advisor to regional, country, and facility leadership, earning trust as a strategic partner rather than a control function
• Partnering with HR, Legal, and Compliance & Ethics to deliver integrated, multidisciplinary guidance on complex, high-stakes matters
• Building and leading a network of relationships with host-country government agencies, law enforcement, industry bodies, and the multinational public/private security community
• Representing the company as a credible, well-connected voice on security across Asia Pacific

What You Bring

• 15+ years of progressive security management experience, preferably in Asia Pacific, including leadership of regional or multi-country programs
• Demonstrated responsibility for security in an environment outside your home country or country of primary residence (required)
• Experience in a large multinational company or an equivalent public/government sector (required)
• Proven ability to influence and advise senior executives, and to lead and inspire teams without relying on formal authority
• Strong strategic and geopolitical acumen, with the ability to turn complex risk into clear business decisions
• Experience building or maturing a security function, including talent, governance, and metrics
• Manufacturing sector experience (preferred)
• CPP, PSP, PSI, or equivalent certification (a plus)

As a Senior Agent Fleet Front Office, you will play a key role in ensuring smooth and efficient FleetOnlineSolutions (FOS) operations, providing effective support to fleet customers, Fleet Service Providers, and internal teams.

You will act as the local first-level support and Help Desk contact for FOS, supporting users, managing system administration, coordinating Back Office processes, and ensuring that activities are delivered in line with Goodyear standards, internal controls, SOX, and local legal requirements.

Working closely with Fleet customers, Fleet Service Providers, Sales, Network & Service, IT, Accounts Receivable, and the Back Office team in Romania, you will contribute to partner satisfaction, operational efficiency, system stability, and continuous process improvement.

• Provide first-level FOS support: Act as the local Help Desk operator for Fleet customers and Fleet Service Providers, resolving day-to-day FOS queries, supporting users, managing user administration, and ensuring a smooth customer and partner experience.
• Manage FOS systems and processes: Maintain FOS frontend and backend settings and ensure that system configurations, processes, and master data are accurate and aligned with business requirements.
• Support customers, vendors, and Sales: Provide effective operational support for FOS, eJob, and FOS Mobile, helping Fleet customers, service providers, and Sales teams resolve issues and use the systems effectively.
• Coordinate Back Office and financial processes: Work closely with the Back Office team in Romania and Accounts Receivable, including supporting VIM invoice approval activities prior to invoice booking and ensuring smooth coordination of related processes.
• Manage eCasing and eClaims activities: Coordinate and support the end-to-end FOS eCasing and eClaims processes, ensuring timely follow-up, accurate information, and effective resolution of operational issues.
• Support system development and testing: Participate in testing activities and implementation of new system developments, working with IT and relevant business teams to identify issues, validate solutions, and support successful releases.
• Ensure compliance and continuous improvement: Monitor processes against internal requirements, SOX controls, and local legal requirements, while collaborating with Network & Service, Sales, IT, and external partners to improve systems, processes, and overall partner satisfaction.

• Education and relevant experience: Bachelor’s degree, with a minimum of 2–3 years of experience in a support function such as Help Desk, customer service, operations, or a similar environment; previous experience with SAP is highly desirable.

Attractive remuneration.

Generous benefits supporting your wellbeing.

Opportunities for professional development within a supportive and collaborative team.

Remote work with flexible schedules (core working hours 10am-4pm CET), allowing you to work alongside talented individuals from around the world.

An opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies and stay at the forefront of the gaming industry.

A diverse and inclusive workplace that celebrates all backgrounds, regardless of race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, or social status.

Company events and wrap-up parties, access to all games released by CI Games and company merchandise.

A chance to be part of something ground-breaking as we shape the future of gaming.

Recruitment Process:

•

Once our Talent Acquisition team receives your application, together with the hiring team, we will review your CV, portfolio and the answers you provided in the application form and if all the boxes are ticked, we're moving to the next stage.

Initial call with Talent Acquisition Specialist - During this call you'll learn about the company and we learn about you.
